project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript booking app with a separate BullMQ worker process
build_system: npm. Scripts: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (tsx --test tests/*.test.ts), build (next build), db:migrate (prisma migrate dev), db:seed, expire-holds (tsx worker/index.ts). Prisma client generated to generated/prisma, imported via @/lib/db. Path alias @/ maps to repo root.
test_framework: node:test run via tsx (tsx --test tests/*.test.ts). Integration tests guard DB-dependent assertions behind `const skip = process.env.DATABASE_URL ? false : "DATABASE_URL not set"` and pass { skip } to each test(). Pure-logic tests (signature.test.ts) run unconditionally.
build_command: npm run typecheck  (and optionally npm run build; next build may require network/DB so typecheck is the reliable gate)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck` (must pass with 0 errors) and `npm test` (all tests pass or skip gracefully when DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL are unset). No live Postgres/Redis/Meta/SMS available in sandbox.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated to generated/prisma via `prisma generate` (runs as part of prisma migrate). It is gitignored-style generated output; schema.prisma is the source of truth. New enums/models in schema.prisma require a hand-written SQL migration under prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_<name>/migration.sql.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in node_modules. No install needed. Baseline: `npm run typecheck` passes, `npm test` passes (DB tests skip when DATABASE_URL unset).
environment_constraints: Assume NO external network access: Postgres (DATABASE_URL), Redis (REDIS_URL), WhatsApp Cloud API, and SMS provider are NOT reachable. Do not rely on live DB/Redis or real provider HTTP calls in tests. Mirror existing tests: skip DB-dependent assertions when DATABASE_URL is unset; make provider send + the send-message job injectable so unit tests run without network. Meta WhatsApp account setup, template approval, and DLT/SMS registration are external manual tasks that CANNOT be done in code (leave those doc checkboxes unchecked).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Conventions inferred from existing code (see key_patterns). Work on branch phase-4-messaging; commit there; do NOT push or open a PR.
key_patterns: Prisma: snake_case columns via @map, @@map table names, cuid ids (@default(cuid())), enums SCREAMING_CASE (BookingStatus, PaymentStatus). FKs onDelete Cascade, @@index like existing models. Migrations: hand-written SQL mirroring 20261008000000_payments (CreateEnum, CreateTable, CreateIndex, AddForeignKey). Queue (lib/queue.ts): BullMQ Queue over IORedis(REDIS_URL,{maxRetriesPerRequest:null}), lazy getQueue(), deterministic jobId, attempts:5, exponential backoff delay 5000, removeOnComplete {age}, removeOnFail:false. Webhooks (app/api/webhooks/payment/route.ts): read raw body with req.text() BEFORE parsing, verify signature (constant-time HMAC in lib/payments.ts), enforce idempotency via webhook_events (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING inside a transaction), return non-2xx on failure to trigger provider retry. Dependency injection for testability: handleRazorpayEvent takes an injectable `enqueue` fn defaulting to the real one; replicate this for whatsapp/sms send + the send-message job. Phone: lib/phone.ts toE164 normalizes (default IN). Env access helper: lib/payments.ts `env(name)` throws if unset.
relevant_files: lib/queue.ts (add send-message queue + enqueueSendMessage, mirror enqueueCreateMeeting)
lib/payment-webhook.ts (currently enqueues create-meeting; cross-phase trigger decision lives here)
lib/payments.ts (env() helper + constant-time HMAC verify pattern to mirror)
app/api/webhooks/payment/route.ts (webhook route shape to mirror for WhatsApp status webhook)
worker/index.ts (currently only hold-expiry setInterval; extend to run BullMQ workers)
app/[influencer]/book/BookingFlow.tsx (confirmation UI; link must be shown here per doc rule)
app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts (booking status endpoint; may expose meetLink)
tests/payments.test.ts + tests/signature.test.ts (test style to mirror: injectable deps, DB skip guard)
directory_structure: app/ = Next.js App Router (api routes under app/api/*, public booking page under app/[influencer]/book). lib/ = server logic (db, holds, payments, payment-webhook, phone, queue, slots, checkout). worker/ = standalone worker process (index.ts). prisma/ = schema + hand-written SQL migrations + seed. tests/ = node:test files run via tsx. doc/ = phase specs (00-overview..06).
